integrity: The proof is symbolic and uniform; the finite computation is only a regression check.
The lower and upper bounds use the exact diagonal 2-WL/counting-game correspondence rather than an asymptotic simulation.
Targeted semantic and web searches found no indexed statement of the exact all-n formula; residual priority risk remains for unindexed folklore.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite simple undirected cycle graphs and counting first-order logic with at most three variables.
Quantifier depth uses the standard nesting convention and the standard ordered-pair 2-WL indexing from atomic equality/edge/nonedge colors.
No claim is made that the formula is new beyond the literature and databases actually inspected; unindexed folklore or theses remain a residual priority risk.
title: Exact three-variable counting depth of finite cycle graphs
